card.text: Eta Carinae is the star inside the Homunculus Nebula, about 2,350 parsecs away.

sources.label: Smith (2006), ApJ 644, 1151
sources.locator: The Homunculus's shape and expansion give 2350 ± 50 pc

introduction.text: Half of its near-infrared light comes from within 4.8 au, about a thousand Suns across; its wind turns opaque at 9,400 K. An unseen companion circles it every 5.54 years.

sources.label: Groh et al. (2010), arXiv:1006.4816
sources.locator: Sect. 4: most of the K-band light comes from a region with a 50% encircled-energy radius of 4.8 AU (Weigelt et al. 2007)

sources.label: Groh et al. (2012), arXiv:1204.1963
sources.locator: Table 2: effective temperature 9400 K at Rosseland optical depth 2/3; orbital parameters adopted from Madura et al. (2012). Sect. 1: an eccentric binary with a period of 5.54 yr
